instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Environmental conservation foundation managing 15 protected area and habitat restoration projects covering 25,000 hectares. We primarily secure funding through international grants and individual donations, requiring rigorous reporting on impact metrics. Our core mission is centered around biodiversity protection, making operational efficiency critical to maximizing grant utilization.
answers.pastInitiatives: We successfully deployed a new CRM system across the operations team 18 months ago, which improved lead tracking and reduced pipeline data entry time by 30%. We are now exploring marketing automation integration specifically for donor segmentation and AI-assisted species identification to enhance monitoring capabilities. These initiatives have largely focused on optimizing existing workflows rather than creating entirely new service lines.
answers.strategicGoals: Our industry is facing structural decline due to technological disruption and changing consumer behavior, necessitating a pivot away from reliance solely on traditional grant structures. We need to identify entirely new value propositions that leverage our brand trust and deep field operational knowledge in adjacent spaces where demand for environmental solutions is growing.
answers.additionalContext: We underwent a significant restructuring 6 months ago, consolidating five business units into three and reducing headcount by 12%. The remaining teams are stretched thin managing the same workload with fewer people. Morale has stabilized but is still recovering; therefore, innovation must be highly focused and demonstrable in its ability to improve existing operational efficiency immediately.
answers.teamSize: We have a small technology team of 4-6 people including developers, a part-time DevOps engineer, and a product manager who also handles project management. The team is fully allocated to maintaining current products and handling integration requests from key clients. Innovation work is done in the margins — there is no formally ring-fenced innovation time or budget.

opportunities.title: Optimized Field Data Pipeline Integration
opportunities.rationale: Leverage existing camera trap and monitoring data with low-cost, off-the-shelf AI tools to automate preliminary biodiversity identification. This improves efficiency without requiring custom software development or significant capital expenditure.

first_actions: Conduct feasibility study for open-source image recognition models
Pilot a specific low-cost API integration with existing data streams
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce manual image processing time by 25% within Q3.
milestones: Q1: Model selection and data pipeline mapping complete
Q2: Pilot run of the automated identification tool on a subset of camera trap footage

opportunities.title: Conservation Data as a B2B Consulting Service
opportunities.rationale: Given the high pressure, we can diversify by packaging our unique, proprietary ecological data and restoration knowledge into specialized consulting packages for private corporations looking for ESG compliance or carbon offset verification. This shifts revenue from pure grants to service-based income.

first_actions: Define the core technical deliverable (e.g., 'Deforestation Risk Score')
Develop a simple sales pitch and pricing model for B2B data access
Establish partnerships with two potential corporate clients.
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure one pilot B2B consulting contract generating $X revenue.
milestones: Q1: Finalize the Service Offering scope and pricing structure
Q3: Secure first paying client commitment.

next_steps.action: Form a cross-functional 'Diversification Task Force' to define 3 potential non-grant revenue streams.
Initiate pilot study for AI image identification using existing internal data.

key_weaknesses: Limited budget severely constrains large, unproven projects.
Culture prioritizes immediate operational demands over dedicated innovation time.
Vague strategy definition hinders clear prioritization between incremental and radical ideas.
